hotels.title: Mont-Tremblant Alpine Escape with Ski-In Ski-Out Access, Day Spa & Five Restaurants & Bars
hotels.description: Surrounded by the natural splendour of Canada's Laurentian Mountains, Fairmont Tremblant blends alpine elegance with world-class hospitality. This luxurious mountain retreat invites guests to unwind in style, with cosy guestrooms, restaurants and lounges offering sweeping views of snow-capped peaks and crystal-clear lakes. After days exploring this breathtaking alpine region, retreat to the hotel’s inviting Moments Spa for a soothing treatment or relax in one of the heated pools overlooking the mountains. Indulge in refined Quebecois cuisine at Choux Gras Brasserie Culinaire or share fireside drinks at Axe Lounge Bar as snowflakes fall beyond the windows. With its perfect balance of rustic warmth and contemporary sophistication, Fairmont Tremblant captures the spirit of mountain luxury in every season.
